missions: Home box: A minor at fret 5
Loop the Intro (just Am) and play Box 1 at fret 5. Start and end every phrase on an A.
The E chord needs a G#
Over E, the pink dot is G#. It is not in A minor, and it is what makes this song sound Middle-Eastern and old-world. Hit it on the E, then resolve up one fret to A.
The Chorus leans toward C major, which uses the same notes as A minor. Use the same box, but end your phrases on C instead of A.
Play one phrase that starts in Box 1 (fret 5) and ends in Box 2 (fret 8).
Try Am add9 and F maj7 from the Color panel, in your strumming and as the last note of a phrase.

special.text: Over E, play G# on the D string at fret 6, between the box frets, with your middle finger. Then step up one fret to A (fret 7) when Dm arrives. A is in Dm, so the step resolves.

guide.record: Solo over the Intro (Am) and in the gaps between sung lines. Keep it simple and singing; this is a ballad.
